facts.activity_file: supporting a load for maintenance access

assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: near hit during an intrusive maintenance task on PR-9410

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear on PR-9410 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically supporting a load for maintenance access. PR-9410 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 30 July 2005 a near hit was recorded on PR-9410 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
